summary:
iter83 verification of P0 + P1 + P2 across backend + web (mobile validated at code-parity). Backend pytest 10/10 PASS (/app/test_reports/pytest/iter83_results.xml). Web UI PASS on P0 Protective-Exit card + P2 deep-link ('Test in Research Lab' on a cloned strategy detail navigates to Research > Validate with the clone pre-selected — the wizard opens on step 2 with the STRATEGY step already checked, and lab run for that clone returns non-zero trades attributed to it via the same endpoint tested in pytest). Iter82 orphan bug is FIXED: DELETE /api/library/{clone-key} now unregisters from /api/strategy/registry (confirmed by curl + pytest test_delete_removes_from_registry). Cleanup: iter83 test clone (clone-6a13f50a) deleted, registry has zero clone-* orphans at end.

Backend pytest (10/10):
  P0 - test_all_four_toggles_persist_false PASS — PUT {structural_stop_enabled, ema_trend_loss_enabled, structure_failure_enabled, strat_exit_enabled} all False → GET roundtrips all False.
  P0 - test_toggles_flip_back_to_true PASS.
  P0 - test_profile_overrides_carry_regime_and_method PASS — profile_overrides.hunter carries {allowed_regimes:['trending'], method:'atr_trailing', trail_arm_pct:2.1, ...} and GET roundtrips.
  P0 - test_clear_profile_overrides PASS.
  P1 - test_import_direct_json_no_ai PASS — POST /api/library/import/direct returns ai_skipped=True + draft id.
  P1 - test_import_direct_rejects_empty PASS (400).
  P1 - test_import_direct_rejects_bad_json PASS (422).
  P2 - test_clone_appears_in_registry PASS.
  P2 - test_lab_backtest_non_zero_trades PASS — clone-XXXX ran to DONE in ~45s, non-zero trades in per_symbol['BTC/USD'], strategy_breakdown attributed to clone.
  P2 - test_delete_removes_from_registry PASS — orphan bug from iter82 CONFIRMED FIXED.

Web UI PASS on: (a) Exit Engine > Risk Monitor: [data-testid='rm-protective-exits'] card renders 4 toggles + Save Settings button; all 4 toggles present with correct data-testid. Screenshot /tmp/iter83_web_riskmonitor.png. (b) P2 deep-link: catalog-test-lab button on clone detail card exists; clicking navigates to /research (Validate wizard); wizard opens on the Dataset step with the STRATEGY step ✓ pre-completed = the clone was pre-selected in step 1. Screenshot /tmp/iter83_web_deeplink.png.

Mobile code-parity confirmed by inspection (this iteration re-uses iter82 mobile evidence). /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:588-596 renders the same 4 toggles (structural_stop_enabled, ema_trend_loss_enabled, structure_failure_enabled, strat_exit_enabled) under testID rm-protective-exits with the same rm-toggle-{key} pattern + rm-save-settings (line 612). /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/strategy.tsx:146-147 renders sections 'LIVE / PAPER' and 'TEST & EDIT'. /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx:136 wires testID='detail-test-strategy' → router.push('/(tabs)/research', {strat: id}). /app/mobile/app/library/import.tsx:146-149 wires testID='import-direct-btn' Save-without-AI.

PARITY GAPS FOUND:
  1. Web Strategy Center does NOT implement the LIVE/PAPER vs TEST & EDIT sectioning that mobile has. StrategyCenter.jsx renders a flat grid at line 147 (grid-cols-2). Mobile /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/strategy.tsx:146-147 correctly groups deployed vs rest. This is a P1 scope item.
  2. Web ImportStrategyModal has NO 'Save without AI' direct-import button. grep '-rn library/import/direct' /app/frontend/src returned 0 hits. Only /app/frontend/src/components/ImportStrategyModal.jsx uses the AI-analyze path (import-analyze-btn / import-approve-btn). Mobile /app/mobile/app/library/import.tsx:146 has testID='import-direct-btn'. This is a P1 scope item.
